Fame is not the threshold "The constitution protects the rights of every individual and it need not be restricted or limited to celebrities like actors and sportspersons." Justice P.B. Balaji, Madras High Court The court also held that Blinkit could not exploit Hari's personality rights, "whatever little it may be", for commercial gain without his consent and prior permission. If people recognise you, a brand needs your permission. This order puts personality rights back on solid ground: identifiability plus commercial use without consent. That protects ordinary people who build a public identity, without turning the right into a tool to silence fans, critics or the news. Adv.
